name: Hafiz Zamri
bio:
Hafiz Zamri's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with aerodynamics, fueled by observing the intricate designs of Formula 1 cars. After completing his engineering degree at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, he landed an internship at a local engineering firm involved in automotive component design. This experience solidified his desire to work in the high-stakes world of racing. 

He joined Stake Sauber five years ago, quickly becoming a reliable wind tunnel operator. Hafiz possesses a sharp eye for detail and a methodical approach to data analysis. While his technical skills are solid, he's known for pushing boundaries in the wind tunnel, always looking for innovative ways to simulate real-world conditions and improve aerodynamic performance. Hafiz is a strong believer in the importance of rigorous testing and data-driven decisions, making him a valued, if sometimes demanding, member of the aerodynamic team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Hafiz is of average height with a stocky build and a focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Insists on listening to traditional Malaysian music while analyzing wind tunnel data.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
